full_judgment: 27. In the case reported in 21 BLC 1, it was decided that before passing an order of attachment before judgment, a court must be satisfied that the defendant has been trying to frustrate the effect of the decree that might be passed against him by disposing of the property or removing it from the jurisdiction of the court. This suspicion must be based on some visible materials which are to be found in the affidavit filed by the party or otherwise.
